test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - General Awareness (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following has similarity to Article 29(1) of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights which states “everyone has duties to the community in which alone the free and full development of his personality is possible”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Duties**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) has concentrated on rights that every person has simply by virtue of being born human.
 
• **Article 29 **says the corollary of rights is duties. We all have a duty to other people, and we should protect their rights and freedoms these are very similar to the Fundamental Duties laid down in the Indian Constitution
 
• **The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976** added 10 Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution. **86th Amendment Act 2002 later added 11th Fundamental Duty to the list**.
 
• **Swaran Singh Committee in 1976 **recommended Fundamental Duties,
 
• The Fundamental Duties are dealt with in **Article 51A **under **Part-IV A **of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The DPSP falls under **Part IV** of the Indian Constitution and the idea of it has been taken from the Irish Constitution.
 
• The **Fundamental Rights** fall under the **Part III **of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
• **Article 12-35** of the Indian Constitution deal with Fundamental Rights which includes the **Right to Equality, the Right to Freedom, the Right against Exploitation, the Right to Freedom of Religion, Cultural and Educational Rights, the Right to Constitutional Remedies**
 
 
 
• The **97th Amendment **granted Constitutional status to cooperative societies and inserted Part IXB in the Constitution which pinpointed several conditions for state laws relating to cooperative societies
